Membership

Join a professional community committed to competence, ethics and the public interest. Applicants must be at least 18 years old. Admission is at the discretion of the Council.

CATEGORIES

Choose the class that fits you

Standard Membership

For practitioners

Persons professionally engaged in taxation practice.

ACTA
Associate (Standard). ACCTA exams + 3 years of relevant experience or a recognised equivalent qualification
FCTA
Fellow (Standard). Associate for 5 years + senior experience + CPD; or qualifications accepted for Fellowship

Academic Membership

For educators

Persons engaged primarily in teaching and research or academic leadership in taxation.

AACTA
Associate Academic. Degree in a related field + 3 years of teaching and research experience in taxation
FACTA
Fellow Academic. Associate Academic for 5 years + significant academic contribution, or equivalent qualifications

Affiliate Membership

Student

For people interested or engaged in taxation-related work who do not yet meet the requirements for Associate membership.

AFCTA
Affiliate. Interested or engaged in taxation, not yet eligible for Associate

Corporate Membership

Firms

For partnerships, companies and other legal entities engaged in taxation and related services.

—
Corporate Member. Firm or entity in taxation services, represented by a nominated ACCTA member

Honorary Membership – FCTA (Hons) / FACTA (Hons)

Conferred by the Council, by invitation only, on distinguished persons who promote the objectives of the Association. No fees are payable.

ROUTES OF ADMISSION

More than one way in

Select one route when you apply. The Council may invite you for an interview / viva, or request further evidence.

ACCTA examinations and practical experience

Associate

Membership of a recognised local professional body

All categories

Recognised foreign qualification or professional membership

All categories

Upgrade from existing ACCTA membership

Fellow, Fellow Academic, Affiliate to Associate

Mature entry — at least 15 years' taxation experience

Associate (Standard only)

Mature entry — at least 25 years' experience, 10 in a senior role

Fellow (Standard only)

FEES

Application fees and annual subscriptions

CategoryLettersApplication FeeAnnual Subscription
Associate (Standard)ACTARs. 3,000Rs. 3,000
Fellow (Standard)FCTARs. 5,000Rs. 5,000
Associate AcademicAACTARs. 3,000Rs. 3,000
Fellow AcademicFACTARs. 5,000Rs. 5,000
AffiliateAFCTARs. 2,000Rs. 2,000
Corporate Member—Rs. 10,000Rs. 10,000
HonoraryFCTA (Hons) / FACTA (Hons)WaivedWaived

Pay the application fee and first annual subscription after the Governing Council approves your application. Membership runs to 31 December and is renewed annually; it lapses if the subscription is three months or more in arrears. Fees are subject to revision by the Council and are not refundable once an application is processed.

HOW TO APPLY

Four steps to membership

1

Check eligibility

Pick one category and one route of admission.

2

Apply online

Complete the online form and upload certified documents and attachments.

3

Review and approval

The MPC Committee reviews; the Council decides. An interview or a viva may be required.

4

Pay and receive certificate

Pay online, receive your membership number and certificate.

Start individual application (M-01)Start corporate application (M-02)
